svg.text: AERIS-10 — 16×8 microstrip patch array, top copper, scale 1:1 — DSN-ANT-01 Rev A — STATUS: PROPOSED DESIGN
Date 2026-10-09 · Units mm · f = 10.50 GHz · RO4350B εr 3.66, h 0.508 mm, Cu 35 µm · generated by tools/design_antenna_array.py from design_parameters.json
First-order transmission-line design (Balanis/Hammerstad). Not simulated, not measured. Requires openEMS tuning (openems_patch_row.py) before fabrication. Decisions D-01…D-06 in 00_DESIGN_BASIS.md.
